svg.aria-label: Animated diagram: an abdominal CT slice goes through a segmentation model; an illustrative predicted hepatic vessel mask, broken and missing small vessels, and the ground-truth mask pass through a shape encoder whose undercomplete branch has a large receptive field for the global shape and whose overcomplete branch has a small receptive field for fine detail; the distance between their codes is sent back to the model as a shape loss, and the vessels are then highlighted on the CT
